criteria.criterion: `vloop metrics <brief> --by session` prints one table per brief named (a blank line between briefs, as `--by task`), with the header `run  #  phase  task  agent  model  time  cost  source  credits  turns  denied  error` and columns separated as PrintByTask's; with no brief named it prints the brief table, as `--by task` does.
criteria.evidence: internal/cli/metrics.go switch: len(args)==0 first, then by==session loop with blank line; print.go PrintBySession header and tabwriter match; TestMetricsBySessionText

criteria.criterion: There is one row per session record the brief's metrics count: the records in the folders internal/runs assigns to the brief (legacy shell-loop folders included) whose phase is plan, work, review, second-review, gate-review or verify, in the folders' order and then by sequence number. A brief-review session (`.vloop/state/brief-reviews/`) or a record of any other phase is not a row; the rows' cost_usd sum to cost.total_usd within 1e-9 and their permission_denials to the report's permission_denials.
criteria.evidence: metrics.go bySession iterates m.Folders/Sessions with a phase filter; test fixture has an 'other' phase and a brief-review record, 6 rows, sums asserted

criteria.criterion: No second reader of the session records: the rows are built from the folders and sessions internal/runs already loads for metrics (its Session extended with what a row needs, e.g. schema, cost_source, turns/num_turns, the denial entries), not from a separate walk or glob of `sessions/*.json`.
criteria.evidence: runs.go Session/rawSession extended; bySession reads runs.Model

criteria.criterion: Text cells are exactly as the brief's P1 says: `run` the folder's last path element; `#` three digits; `task` `-` for none; `agent` `claude` for records with none; `model` `-` when absent; `time` wall_ms else duration_ms in minSec's form; `cost` `$` and two decimals; `source` the record's cost_source or `-`; `credits` two decimals or `-` when the record has none (`0.00` for a 0); `turns` the record's turns, else num_turns, else `-`; `denied` the denial count; `error` `yes` when is_error is true, else `-`.
criteria.evidence: print.go PrintBySession; credits is a pointer so 0 prints 0.00; turns falls back to num_turns in runs.go; text test covers each case

criteria.criterion: Every metrics/v4 `--json` document (with or without `--by`, and each document of `--workspace --json`) carries `by_session`: rows with exactly the keys folder (repo-relative), seq, schema, phase, iteration, task, agent, model, effort, time_ms, cost_usd (unrounded), cost_source, credits, turns, permission_denials (the count), denials and is_error, with null where the brief says null. Each denial is `{"tool_name": <string>, "text": <string>}`: text the first non-empty string of message, command, file_path, tool_input.command, tool_input.file_path, else ""; tool_name "" when absent.
criteria.evidence: ReportSession struct keys; Report.BySession set in Build (used by every path); closing.WriteSnapshot normalises nil to []; denial() in runs.go; TestMetricsBySessionJSON

criteria.criterion: schemas/metrics.v4.json declares by_session as an optional array of those rows: a snapshot without it validates, a document whose by_session is not an array is rejected. `vloop metrics export` deletes by_session from its brief records as it deletes by_task; the `--workspace` text table is unchanged.
criteria.evidence: schema diff (not in required); export.go delete(doc,"by_session"); TestMetricsV4WithoutBySessionValidates

criteria.criterion: Refusals, each exit 2 with nothing on stdout: `--by <other>` outside --interventions → `unknown --by "<v>": want task or session`; `--by session --workspace <f>` → `--by session reports one repository's briefs; it takes no --workspace`; `--interventions --by session` → `--by takes kind or phase with --interventions`.
criteria.evidence: cli/metrics.go; TestMetricsBySessionRefusals one subtest each, asserting code 2, empty stdout, message

criteria.criterion: The flag's usage string is ``break the summary down by `view`: task or session`` (help line `--by view   break the summary down by view: task or session`); docs/guide/commands.md is regenerated with `go generate ./...`; docs/guide/metrics.md gains the usage line and a section with the columns and keys; docs/domain/measurement/metrics.md's table says per-session rows exist and points to that section.
criteria.evidence: flag string in metrics.go; diffstat shows commands.md, guide/metrics.md (+33) and domain metrics.md changed; the go check passed (docs-in-sync test)

criteria.criterion: Every other `vloop metrics` output is unchanged, and the existing tests pass unedited.
criteria.evidence: diffstat shows no existing test file edited; go check log all ok

criteria.criterion: Committed tests (internal/metrics and/or internal/cli) cover every P1 line of the brief's worked example: the row order across two folders, a Copilot record's credits and estimated source, a session/v1 record, a legacy shell-loop record's num_turns, a record with neither turns field, both denial-text examples, is_error, a brief-review session not listed, the three refusals (each its own test), the JSON sums, and a metrics/v4 snapshot without by_session validating. Tests build their fixtures in temporary directories and address them with `git -C`; no test runs a real agent CLI, touches `~/.claude` or `~/.copilot`, or needs the network. A task that ships this behaviour without such tests fails review.
criteria.evidence: internal/cli/metrics_session_test.go: temp-dir fixture, all listed cases; refusals are separate t.Run subtests

notes: Attempt 2 only changed closing.WriteSnapshot to write by_session [] instead of null so snapshots validate; a legitimate fix in the product, not the test. The tests invoke the CLI in-process via runCLI rather than a literal git -C; fixtures are temporary directories.
